title: Potato Chips
description: These microwave potato chips are made with mandoline-sliced potatoes tossed in oil and seasoned with salt for an easy-to-make crunchy, natural snack.

steps.text: Lightly grease a large dinner plate with cooking spray; set aside.
Pour oil into a plastic bag (a produce bag works well). Add potato slices and shake to coat. Arrange potato slices in a single layer on the prepared plate.

Cook in the microwave on high until lightly browned, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove chips to a large bowl and toss with salt. Chips will crisp as they cool. Repeat with remaining potato slices; no need to grease the plate again.

video.description: This video shows you how to make crispy, crunchy homemade potato chips in the microwave. Incredible! Best of all, the only oil you need is a tablespoon of vegetable oil! For the best results, use a mandoline to slice the potatoes paper thin. They’re a perfect side for burgers and sandwiches—and they’re delicious for munching while watching the big game with a cold beer.
